<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$facial(1,1)>Um, so... My head was hurting really bad earlier, <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,13)>so I

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I see... Well, maybe someday when I feel brave enough,

dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Sabias que o ar à tua volta cheira mesmo,

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Well, a long time ago I was hanging out with a friend on a

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Bem, há muito tempo atrás eu andava com um amigo num...
Um dia quente, e de repente...<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,5)>Eles explodiram.
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,48)>Foi muito surpreendente!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Uh-huh. So that’s why I thought, y’know—if you put this air
